verdict.rationale: Rive documents a first-party MCP server for the desktop editor with tools to create/manage Rive files, build shapes/layouts/component instances, edit state machines, keyframes, data binding, and scripts/shaders — clearly a write-capable agent surface, not just read access. This is corroborated by both docs and a runtime probe of the actual MCP integration doc, plus RML as a text-based file format for coding-agent workflows. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community verification of the MCP tools actually working, and no public API/OpenAPI spec confirming programmatic write access outside the editor.
